title: Twin Configuration
description: Schema for twin.json files that define a twin's identity, SDK target, and default port.

name.description: Machine-readable twin name, matching the directory suffix (twin-{name}).

description.description: Brief description of what the twin simulates.

category.description: Service category (e.g., payments, email, analytics, loyalty, auth).

sdk.description: Primary SDK or API this twin targets.

package.description: SDK package name or API identifier.

default_port.description: Default port the twin listens on.
